notes.title: Demo Version 0.71
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/a4d4c678653f405015ef8023bda496ae0be573ba.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Hello There![/b][/p][p][/p][p]The game version reached 0.71 and with it, I'm happy to introduce one of the main features of this game: [b]Custom Chapters[/b].[/p][p]While this version was in the initial roadmap and the 0.7x version plan, I've decided to focus on development, canceling the Early Access (at least for now) and try to release the game as a whole on January.[/p][p]Detailed post about the new roadmap will be published soon, but for now, I want to show off the game's new feature a bit.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Custom Chapters[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/afbfcd01ad113fe3ae7dea3aba33f0efd82a22db.png"][/img][/p][p]The game doesn't have to end when the story ends.[/p][p]While the main game is story driven and scripted with some beautiful voice acting, you have a chance to play a custom chapter with characteristics you choose for yourself.[/p][p][/p][p]Take Valliant with you to rescue Princess Rebecca from Lord Sinclair's castle.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/4401e63e91aa802a1b2d612debbfd442c34768d2.png"][/img][/p][p]Survive a deadly ambush in the woods with a fellow guard by your side.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/38471c77be14e22df6ba3b749722fdaf057b2f8f.png"][/img][/p][p]Help protect Kate from a group of raiding bandits.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/c65eb6e6d5b3e4fd57fa5be2c38962cab7cf1aa1.png"][/img][/p][p]Currently implemented play modes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Rescue the Princess[/b] - A selected princess will be spawned in a random location, behind a locked door. Find the key and escort the princess to safety.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ambush[/b] - Survive a deadly ambush by a selected group of enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Duel[/b] - Have a friendly (almost) duel with a selected opponent.[/p][/*][/list][p]You can choose to take a sidekick with you to some of these objectives.[/p][p]More play modes will be added.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo contains a limited amount of locations and characters to choose from.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Cheers![/b][/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.70
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/bc63c159462d92bfcb1d130089c3d95fdd65f6f1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Hi There![/b][/p][p][/p][p]The game version reached 0.70 and if you read the previous [b][i]Roadmap[/i][/b] post, that's a major milestone for the game as one of the 0.7x versions will be the first early access version.[/p][p]So now:[/p][olist][*][p]Demo version 0.70 is released.[/p][/*][*][p]Beta version 0.70, containing levels 1 to 7, is released but still in a closed beta. Worry not, though! The early access version is coming soon.[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p]If you read the previous Demo 0.60 post, I may sound like a broken record, but I had so much fun working on this one.[/p][p]Aside for the added level 7, the main concept of this version is interaction / physics.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Interaction / Physics[/h2][p][/p][p]Disclaimer: This kind of a topic is best viewed in a video, so I'll create one soon and upload it to my YouTube channel. Stay tuned![/p][p]Some of the feedback I got about the game is that it is lacking the world "responding" to the player.[/p][p]They were right. The world indeed was too static and mainly based on Guard - Goat interaction, but no more than that.[/p][p]So, I've added a few things.[/p][p][/p][h3]Destructible Objects[/h3][p]Some barrels, crates, chairs and etc can be destroyed if you hit them with your sword or if they are being hit a few times with an arrow (even a guard's arrow).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/0aaca6b140fd51dfc5c6f8d302732a44eb21f0b5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/5eedbecf0692f03813f00f8f026a5d1d417aea99.png"][/img][/p][h3]Physical Objects[/h3][p]Some small objects will fly around upon being hit with a sword or an arrow.[/p][p][/p][h3]Traps[/h3][p]Aside from a sword and a bow, now you have yet another weapon to defeat your enemies with: Your creativity.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/68b4a7f1ccdd23469a515c50fabad58bcc8b8980.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/fefca64678170fdfff252d5d549bfc33df5397fb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/fcdbe7392f6931f578b261bea1ff2bed959cbf01.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Moonray Healing[/h2][p][/p][p]As I promised, the Moonray Crystals collected in the game will have two functions. One in-game and one in the Custom Chapters.[/p][p]Introducing the in-game function:[/p][p]Now, whenever Goat's health reaches zero, if he has a Moonray Crystal in his inventory, he will be healed in return of one crystal.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]What Else?[/h2][p][/p][p]Version 0.70 also has some small additions and fixes and some of them can be noticed in the demo as well:[/p][list][*][p]Still in the [i]interaction[/i] area: Now, hitting something with a sword will make a sound.[/p][/*][*][p]Chose a better hit sound for plate armor (when hitting knights).[/p][/*][*][p]Added another female guard voice. Also by Melanie Doll. She sent it to me along with the one I already added but I didn't add the second set until now. Check out Melanie doing a strong and mean British accent.[/p][/*][*][p]Two new music tracks by Lottie Kordbarlag. They are awesome! Check them out. Especially the new exploration track - it is hypnotizing.[/p][/*][*][p]Settings menu is now split into categories.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a setting to turn off the edge blur.[/p][/*][*][p]Better menu colors.[/p][/*][*][p]Now you can skip the tutorial also in Kate's dialog.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved guards detecting bodies.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded Castle Sinclair's barracks area.[/p][/*][*][p]Added some fun elements to the training area.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked Castle Sinclair's castle wall textures yet again. Now I love it even more.[/p][/*][*][p]Some cosmetic fixes and graphical adjustments.[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: Fixed a glitch sometimes happening on backstab.[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: Fixed guards sometimes standing in front of the player without attacking.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Closing Words[/h2][p][/p][p]If you are following these update posts, you'll see that I keep mentioning the word "feedback".[/p][p]I am listening to my players (except for one that told me not to release this game).[/p][p]This is the exact reason I'm going early access. It is a way for me to expose the game to a larger audience and get more feedback.[/p][p]So, if you played the demo and you have a feedback, please don't be shy![/p][p]I'm not promising to apply every comment I'll receive, but so far the comments were pretty much spot-on and I think I applied most of them. At least, the ones that I could.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Cheers![/b][/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.60
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/23d46a0bea5b69a7e9c8559cc2e1a30159623e60.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hello there![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Game development is in version 0.60 at the moment and this means:[/p][olist][*][p]Released version 0.60 of the demo.[/p][/*][*][p]Released an internal Beta version 0.60 containing levels 1 to 6.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Version 0.60 introduces level 6 which is slightly different from levels 1 to 5.[/p][p]I had a LOT of fun working on that one and I hope the players will have as much fun playing it.[/p][p]News item about level 6 along with level 5 will come in separate.[/p][p][/p][p]Here I want to talk about the demo which contains the 0.60 changes to the game engine.[/p][p]So let's begin.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Stealth[/h1][p][/p][p]Initially this game was planned as an action only game. Kinda like a 3D version of 80s swordplay platformer games (I don't know if I'm allowed to mention names here).[/p][p]Recent comments added on top of a personal sense of lack in gameplay made me realize there is room for one more big aspect to this game which I'm able to implement. And so I did.[/p][p][/p][h3]Hiding Bodies[/h3][p]You are now able to drag bodies to secluded areas.[/p][p]A guard stumbling upon a body will be alert and start chasing you, so don't leave bodies lying around in central places like corridors.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/c894a27c1f4ad56f2b66150ff6095394a18d48fd.png"][/img][/p][h3]Disguising As A Guard[/h3][p]You can steal guard uniforms.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/39588af890f32ab43111e81e1b2b320090edb91c.png"][/img][/p][p]While wearing a guard uniform, you are less likely to be detected, but if you come too close to a guard, you will be detected and your disguise will be revealed.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/5260cd1bfedb6b30c5d5740f7bccddaaae291fce.png"][/img][/p][h3]More Sneaking Elements[/h3][p]Some of these were already existing in previous versions and some are now more polished:[/p][list][*][p]Crouching reduces the chance to be detected.[/p][/*][*][p]Striking a guard from behind will cause a back-stab.[/p][/*][*][p]In addition to above, every strike to a guard, whether with a blade or an arrow, while you are not detected, will cause instant take down.[/p][/*][*][p]An alerted guard will trigger nearby guards.[/p][/*][*][p]A defeated guard will trigger nearby guards.[/p][/*][*][p]Missing a guard with an arrow will trigger all guards close the the arrow's impact area.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h1]What Else?[/h1][p][/p][h3]Moonray Crystals[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/50e4300d956be7625b0bb14af3ab9b99bb4227d5.png"][/img][/p][p]Collect Moonray Crystals.[/p][p]Aside from being a nice collectible, two features will be added to them in the following versions. One in-game and one in [b]Custom Chapter[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]In addition to a news item about level 5 and 6, there is a major announcement coming up, so stay tuned![/p][p]In the mean time, check out the demo. It's even more fun now.[/p][p]Please wishlist if you haven't done so yet. Every +1 to the wishlists gives me a major morale boost and helps me in the development.[/p][p]Also don't forget, I'm developing this game for you! If you have a comment, suggestion or a bug report, I'll be happy to hear it.[/p][p]Me, in the meantime, will work on level 7 and all the shebang around it.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Thanks for reading![/b][/p][p][b]Cheers![/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.53
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/c4dc813b81c27911b78eb255502cf7f4bc442119.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Hello there![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Game development is in version 0.53 at the moment and this means:[/p][olist][*][p]Released version 0.53 of the demo.[/p][/*][*][p]Released an internal Beta version 0.53 containing levels 1 to 5.[/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/3d4148c23f19a57a55550a01bbd7faf1460b92ee.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Introducing Another Combat Mode: Hack & Slash[/h2][p]While my personal preferences are the timed and directional combat modes, I've noticed most of the demo players actually prefer the good old hack & slash combat system, usually seen in many RPG games.[/p][p]So, while keeping the existing modes, I've decided to add yet another combat mode to the game: Hack & Slash.[/p][p]In Hack & Slash, there is no perfect blocking, neither by the enemy nor by the player.[/p][p]Every hit counts.[/p][p]Every hit reduces health. The amount varies by the attack's timing and if the enemy/player were blocking.[/p][p]Player has the ability for continuous block.[/p][p]In this mode, timing is not important for player blocking, so you can hold the block key.[/p][p]My suggestion:[/p][p]In the intro/training level, try all modes and see what gives you more enjoyment.[/p][p]I've also added a small info button in the intro/training level which explains the modes thoroughly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/e6a51abc9679ea89f2de5641c11398749e46a27c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]What's More Inside?[/h2][list][*][p]Thrust me! I had trouble with both first-person and enemy thrust animations. First-person one didn't look like a good old thrust, and the enemy one looked more like an attack from the left, which is very confusing for Directional combat mode players. So, I reworked these two.[/p][/*][*][p]Speaking of thrust, added a first person stab animation as a finisher animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Speaking of finisher animations, added an infrastructure for finisher animations, so stay tuned for that one.[/p][/*][*][p]All of the above gave me the appetite for doing a back-stab animation. It is nice, but I may want to improve it a bit later on. So now, you can sneak up your enemies and give them a good old back-stab.[/p][/*][*][p]Having a shield in hand matters. In Timed combat mode, having a shield in hand blocks enemy arrows. In Hack & Slash combat mode, holding the block key with shield in hand will deliver less damage from arrows. No shields in Directional mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Sneaking matters. You are less likely to get detected when sneaking.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy alert! Enemies now get alerted when:[/p][list][*][p]They hear a nearby guard detecting the player.[/p][/*][*][p]An arrow hits close to them.[/p][/*][*][p]When near a corpse.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Enemy swordsmen fully charge you when you draw your bow.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy archers stand their ground. Gotta say, this is one of my personal favorite improvements. I love having a cover shoot-out with the archers :)[/p][/*][*][p]Now you can take shields from defeated guards.[/p][/*][*][p]General improvements to enemy attack animations and timing.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a level summary window. It will be appended with more stuff later on.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Sinclair's castle's wall material to look slightly better.[/p][/*][*][p]Better foliage in:[/p][list][*][p]Sinclair's castle.[/p][/*][*][p]Training level.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]FPS (Frames Per Second, not First Person Shooter hehe) improved in most levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Lord Gerald's throne room now has guards.[/p][/*][*][p]Added two more guard models to Sinclair's castle (thus - the demo) including female guards. Yet, in Sinclair's castle, the original models appear more.[/p][/*][*][p]Locked the section-finish door in level 1's second section (now you need to find the key). I want players to explore a bit and not just run to the end of the corridor. Sorry speedrunners :)[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: When striking an archer too fast while drawing a sword, the archer would stay with an empty hand.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/ad6cbfde3d133419016930a09fae891f85c6d6aa.png"][/img][/p][p]Will release a teaser news item about level 5 soon.[/p][p]Working on level 6 right now and it is going to be very special for me and I hope for the players as well.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thanks[/b] to whoever played the demo, streamed the demo, wrote comments and wishlisted.[/p][p]It is appreciated and I hope you enjoyed it and I hope the game will be pretty enjoyable as development goes on.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Have fun![/b][/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.41
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/23a3cfc895e3c8182f717b31c9dfe128e090a5df.png[/img]


[b]Hi there![/b]

Level 4 is done. A news post about it will be posted very soon.

After the demo release and during the time of the Next Fest, I've received some important and precious feedback.
At that point, I've decided to work in two dimensions: Add more content and enhance the game.
I wanted to make a big enhancement break after finishing level 5.
Then, I've got the privilege of watching the lovely Dani Finn which is the voice actress of Lady Drucilla (level 4 and [b]no-spoilers[/b]...) and also a streamer, playing the demo and I understood that some key elements in the demo need to be sharpened in order for new players to enjoy it a bit more.
So I made a couple (more than a couple) of additions, fixes and tweaks and uploaded Demo version 0.41.

Before proceeding to the details, I would like to thank each and everyone who played the demo and left feedback.
Yes, I want this game to succeed, but moreover, I want people to just enjoy it so your feedback is precious to me and to potential players, so thank you! :)


[h2]So, What's Inside?[/h2]
[list]
[*] More guard voices.
[*] Two more music tracks.
[*] Added a few more sword hit/whoosh, bow pull/release sound effects.
[*] Different footstep sounds on grass and dirt.
[*] Body hit sounds for chainmail wearing characters and plate wearing character.
[*] Very few combat timing related modifications which made the combat for personally me - more fun. I hope it is not me alone. In any case, more combat and enemy AI enhancements will come in the future.
[*] Stamina drains less on strike. Now you can spam that attack button on 'Timed' mode.
[*] In addition to above, added a small chance to double strike the enemy successfully. If I see this direction picks up, I may add a third combat option "Hack and Slash" where you can fight the enemy like a hack and slash game. Tell me if this is something you prefer.
[*] Made the player sword block direction compatible with the enemy attack direction in 'Timed' mode to make it look more natural.
[*] Removed the invisible blocker in Lord Gerald's throne room. Now you can go behind Lord Gerald and... I don't know...
[*] Added an info box at the first appearance of each mode. You can see two in the demo's two modes: Exploration Mode and Horde Mode.
[*] Added useful tips.
[*] Game starts with the tutorial but you can skip it. Consider playing it if you are not familiar with the game.
[*] In level 1, you start a bit farther and not right next to the tower.
[*] Fixed the wooden sound when William gets hit by an arrow.
[*] UI display of available weapons.
[*] Tapping a weapon number again sheaths that weapon.
[*] Applied the beautiful artwork of Schwarky Art - Johanna Schmidt in the main menu.
[*] Added fall damage.
[/list]

That's it. I hope you'll like it.

[b]Enjoy![/b]

notes.title: The Journey to the Official Release
notes.notes:
[b]Hi there![/b]

It has been a super busy month for the guards and for the goats so I have lots to share.


[h2]The Past[/h2]

Major milestones accomplished:
[olist]
[*] The official demo was released.
[*] GvG participated in Steam Next Fest!
[/olist]
Two important things happened thanks to the above two:
[olist]
[*] The game got more exposure.
[*] I've got some important comments about the demo which I intend to apply to the game.
[/olist]

[h2]The Present[/h2]

In parallel to the demo and the Next Fest mania, I've continued developing the game and finished level 2 and 3.
Level 3 introduces new game modes: [b]Boss Fight[/b] and [b]Run[/b].
Now working on level 4 and level 4 will add a new spirit to the game:
[list]
[*] A new castle.
[*] New guards. Models and [b]voices[/b]!
[*] A new boss.
[/list]
Reminding you that castles and bosses that are unlocked in story mode can be used in custom chapter mode.


[h2]Images from Level 2 and 3[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/9847c705320b4a2115b17c682aa6ff1691d2ea36.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/0f25f34763b7c17406f2d620b8757d07a0417e06.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/952dc94376529c5ca0de54513f5991fcacfba63a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/567a1fdab00b9a122322f586722d92ae8ad22a48.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/714696665ccf71d717357431ccf08202f06ab3d8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/c09f9e7a072ade79b7586d99a73f076cbfc65e29.png[/img]Boss Fight

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/e1eb03b48b699148dd39e4473dbe8db23f7c6d3f.png[/img]Run


[h2]The Future[/h2]

Hoping to finish level 4 soon, I'll be glad to share info about level 4 in more detail + screenshots and perhaps a promo video or two.
Then, level 5, naturally.
My original plan was to take a pause when level 5 is finished and apply some of the comments I've received for the demo. I might decide to do that sooner - when level 4 is done. Depends on my momentum.
Either way, when those comments are applied, I'll release an updated version of the demo, of course (level 1).
Then, I'll be glad to say that I'm halfway to the official release :) So exciting!


Thanks to everyone who wishlisted, commented and played the demo!

[b]Cheers![/b]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.18
notes.notes:
[h2]What's inside?[/h2]


Introducing Dark Mode.
Gives the game darker lighting, where some areas can be pretty dark.
Dark Mode can be toggled in the settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/7ff8ce16c07177743efb08e46ad861c853da5917.png[/img]Dark Mode off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/36f09c0ef66bf03d976fe2d23bf89ad785ebacaa.png[/img]Dark Mode on.


So what is darkness without a torch to light your way?
Added a torch to the player. Press the T button to pop it up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/6832525894c0330536cc6865744f90860fee7da1.png[/img]

Also revised some first person animations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/312f54c3923343d2a18f202e5605eca9d6cf80f5.png[/img]


[h2]Smaller stuff:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Aside from (and because of) the Dark Mode, enhanced the game lighting and some materials to look slightly better. This means that even if you don't want to play in Dark Mode, graphics will still look improved a bit.
[*] Reduced guards field of view just a bit to give the player more chance to perform a sneak attack.
[*] Slightly more stuff to loot.
[*] Added level borders to the training level. (thanks Salvo)
[*] Updated the splash screen.
[*] Bugfix: Guards with shields where slide-walking when on patrol.
[*] Bugfix: Arrows were attaching to level borders.
[/list]

[b]Enjoy![/b]
